description.value: Prince Motel is a 45-room independently operated motel in central downtown Prince George, offering newly renovated rooms ranging from standard queens to kitchenette suites. The property is pet-friendly and provides cold-weather electrical plug-ins in the parking lot—a practical feature for travellers in northern BC. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of multiple restaurants and grocery stores.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich, confirming an active 45-room motel in downtown Prince George. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed throughout ('Free High-Speed Wireless Internet' and 'Free Wireless High Speed Internet 24/7'); nearby restaurants and grocery stores are confirmed by specific website phrases. No mention of bike storage, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content. The OSM phone (+1-250-562-4900) differs from the toll-free number prominently displayed on the website (1-877-624-8485), flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM phone number (+1-250-562-4900) differs from the toll-free number prominently shown on the website (1-877-624-8485); both may be valid lines but the discrepancy should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel in downtown Prince George with a live website and bookable rooms; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the central BC corridor.
